results.segment: Your appointment about your annual review with Marlow Ridge Surgery is booked for 22 April 2026 at 4.05pm.
Please wait in the seating area until your name is called.
Please bring photographic identification with you on the day.
Please ask your previous provider for a written summary before your appointment.
If the date no longer suits you, our reception team can offer another.
The scheme closes to new applications on 31 October, and you joined some years before that.
